text_block_list.text:
—An era-defining battle: the "Takarazuka 
Kinen."

"Describing the contenders, the media 
dubbed them the 'Big Four.'"

It was the generation of monsters. 
Gentildonna, the heroic queen. Gold Ship, 
the tempestuous rebel of the Kikuka.

"Charging in there is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) champion, Fenomeno, and—"
—The Absolute Tyrant, Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Nay.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall not run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Meno & Golshi
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Are you serious!

Orfevre withdrew from the Takarazuka 
Kinen, suddenly changing plans to focus 
entirely on adjustments for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... I can't believe this! Trainer! 
Pass me those rice crackers over there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yay.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss!? Don't just blend in with them! And 
Gold Ship-san, please stop ordering the 
Boss around like that!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: As an ally of justice, I resolutely—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—, get out onto the track right this 
instant, sir! We are doing a matched run!
"CASE: Bomb Squad"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, our magazine had hyped it up as a 
"clash of the Big Four," so I never 
imagined it would turn into a "clash of 
the Big Three"...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! There must have been countless 
fans praying for that to happen! However—
(WOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To the fans, a clash between the "Big 
Three" is both long-awaited—and immensely 
valuable.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOO! OOH OOH AHH AHH, WHOOP WHOOP!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
S-t-o-p t-h-r-e-a-t-e-n-i-n-g e-a-c-h 
o-t-h-e-r!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Wouldn't that be fine?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You were awarded 'Umamusume of the Year' 
last year, weren't you? Congratulations."

"Umamusume of the Year." That title is an 
honor bestowed upon the Umamusume who 
performed the most brilliantly throughout 
the year.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems last year's results were 
fairly evaluated.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And yet you settle for just the 'Big 
Three'. Not to mention treating someone 
who won't even race as the peak.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...That's an insult to true power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I shall not be holding back 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I must thoroughly crush everything and 
demonstrate the true value of power.

text_block_list.name: Meno & Golshi
text_block_list.text: ...Haha... Ahhh...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What should we do, Boss? They're sayin' 
we're not even worth their time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I will be the one to win here, and I 
will be the one to defeat Orfe-san as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ―― Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, how quite courageous.
